newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat mostly lower after mixed day.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat mostly lower after mixed day.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended a mixed day mostly lower, traders said.
The main bearish factor was the value of sterling, traders said. The UK currency saw an early peak of 2.8201 against the mark, but fell back to 2.8051/61 later in the day on a retreat in dollar mark.

Trade in May and July was boosted by switches as the May expiry approaches, one trader said. July was 1.00 stg down at one point, but was bid back up to 0.50 stg lower at 96.50 stg, as buyers took advantage of lower prices, one trader said.

On the new crop, November got up to 96.25 stg on consumer led buying in the face of active selling by merchants, the trader said. But it was sold down near the close to end 0.75 stg lower at 95.25 stg.
November was the most active contract on wheat, with 367 lots changing hands.
On barley, 35 of a total 37 lots were on November, which last traded 0.75 stg higher at 92.25 stg.
